change_policy: Source/rule changes require a new preserved stage. No outcome-dependent tuning.
known_outcomes: I83/I85 old baseline event already known; all fixed new1ms reductions prospective.

reductions.causal_limit: One exact unchanged replay establishes timing, force balance and associations. No same-state control intervention; do not claim a controller cure, unique initiating mechanism, incorrect observer or contact loss lasting a full5ms from one final-solve sample. I43 already tested whole-target smoothing with mixed results.
reductions.fixed_axes: World XYZ and fixed normal/downhill/cross-slope axes constructed from controller normal at105.4s. Never integrate projections onto changing tangent directions.
reductions.force_accounting: At each completed 1ms solve sum signed exported contact force, gravity and recorded world external disturbance. force*0.001 is sampled impulse, not an exact solver impulse. Retain rejected and nonpositive-normal rows.
reductions.momentum: Use exact mirror-model masses/local COM offsets and recorded pre/post states for analytic whole-robot COM velocity. Compare momentum change against sampled force integral for each1ms and5ms interval and fixed windows. Root velocity is separately reported; internal rotation can change root velocity without the same whole-COM acceleration.
reductions.observer: Compare completed5ms physical wrench against saved observer interval mean at the following row. Apply fixed100rad/s physical wrench filter seeded once from native filtered wrench at105s. No fitted lag.
reductions.recovery: Reuse unchanged I83 intended-section spatial velocity/path and native-up bands. Prefix cannot measure full133s sustained recovery or acceptance.
reductions.reference: Track current observer normal, native desired up direction and its finite-difference rate, supplied angular-rate reference, holding/equilibrium and exact LQR error blocks. Algebraic block sizes or correlations are not independent physical causes.
reductions.scope: Unchanged native B060 diagnostic, not an intervention or accepted recovery fix.
reductions.time_alignment: Held command at row h applies to five1ms solves, interval endpoint is row h+1. New command computed at endpoint cannot cause the already-recorded velocity change; previous held command can contribute.
